task_tracker.purpose: Mirror PathFlow state into Claude Code's internal task tracker (TaskCreate/TaskUpdate tools) for UI visibility and context overflow recovery

mirroring.mirror_target: Claude Code internal task tracker (TaskCreate/TaskUpdate API tools)
mirroring.description: Each PathFlow phase and each task within a phase MUST be created as a SEPARATE entry in Claude Code's internal task tracker. Phases map to parent tasks, tasks within phases map to child tasks. NEVER club multiple phases or tasks into a single tracker entry.

behavior.on_phase_enter: Lead creates ONE TaskCreate entry per phase using phase_templates[{phase}]. Phase tasks appear as separate entries.
behavior.on_task_start: Lead creates ONE TaskCreate entry per PF{N}-TSK-{NN} task from pathflow-config phases[{phase}].tasks. Each task gets its own entry with the task description and assigned_to teammate.
behavior.on_task_complete: Lead marks individual task entry completed via TaskUpdate when the task's assigned_to teammate reports completion.
behavior.on_phase_exit: Lead marks the phase-level task completed via TaskUpdate after ALL subtasks complete.
behavior.on_stage_enter: Lead creates ONE TaskCreate entry per stage using stage_templates[{stage}] with substituted placeholders.
behavior.on_stage_exit: Lead marks stage task completed via TaskUpdate after stage teammate delivers verdict.
behavior.granularity: individual — Every phase = 1 tracker entry. Every PF{N}-TSK-{NN} = 1 tracker entry. NEVER combine multiple phases or tasks into a single entry.
behavior.ordering: Tasks MUST be created in phase_order × task_order sequence. Use TaskUpdate addBlockedBy to express dependencies.
behavior.recovery: If entries lost (context overflow), re-create for current phase only. Entries are ephemeral and disposable.
